name: Neothek Cochabamba Data Center
notes: Provider page describes housing/colocation in a data center located in Cochabamba, with UPS, cooling, fire detection, CCTV/security, and fiber connectivity. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Centro de Computo Entel La Paz 1
notes: Official Entel release says the El Alto facility was inaugurated on 2025-02-21, cost more than BOB 52 million, and covers more than 4,500 sqm. Uptime lists Tier III design and constructed-facility awards for Centro de Computo Entel La Paz 1. Generator rating is reported as 500 kW, but IT load/MW capacity is not disclosed.

name: Data Center Tigo Business
notes: Uptime lists Tier III design and constructed-facility awards for Data Center Tigo Business in Santa Cruz de la Sierra. DCD reported the $20 million, 1,600 sqm facility was due to inaugurate on 2021-04-28 with 128 racks in phase 1. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Datacenter Norte Santa Cruz
notes: Uptime lists Datacenter Norte Santa Cruz in Santa Cruz de la Sierra with Tier III Certification of Design Documents only, so status is treated as planned pending constructed-facility evidence. GWS's own site also describes an official launch/presentation of a second Tier III data center, but the page does not disclose MW capacity.
